title: Directory of 30 accredited private cybersecurity, cloud computing, and DevOps academies in Nigeria
description: Compile a verified, high-value directory of 30 active private cybersecurity, cloud computing, Linux administration, and DevOps academies across Lagos, Abuja, Port Harcourt, and Enugu. Deliver: (1) Structured Directory Table: Academy/Center Name, City & State, Physical Training Center Address, Official Website or Verified LinkedIn Portal, and Curriculum Focus (e.g. AWS Cloud Solutions Architect, Ethical Hacking, SOC Analyst). (2) Decision Maker Profile: Verified Director of Training, Chief Instructor, or Admissions Coordinator name with public contact email or official phone number. (3) Cohort Schedule & Class Size: Document cohort duration (e.g. 10 weeks, 3 months) and typical batch size per intake. (4) Verification Source Log: Exact URL and timestamp of verification for every listed academy. Strictly zero unverified entries.
rationale: High-ticket cybersecurity and DevOps bootcamps require intensive technical collaboration and represent immediate high-intent buyers for Zedu Pro.

currentDelivery.title: Done: 20 verified academies (of 30 asked), with a verification log and rejected list
currentDelivery.body:
Checked every entry on the academy's own live page on 24 Oct 2026: 20 rows (19 academies; Loctech has campuses in both Port Harcourt and Enugu) across Lagos (8), Abuja (4), Port Harcourt (6) and Enugu (2). Each row has the published address, website, curriculum focus, cohort length or intake info as stated, and an official contact. The verification log lists the exact URL for every row.

Two honest limits: (1) I could verify 20, not 30. The task says 'strictly zero unverified entries', so I didn't pad the list; the 13 candidates I rejected are listed with their reasons. (2) No verified page publicly names a training director or admissions lead, so the decision-maker column says 'not public' plus the official admissions email or phone. I didn't take names from personal profiles. Batch sizes are given only where a page states them (most don't). Nobody was contacted.

# Directory: private cybersecurity, cloud and DevOps academies in Lagos, Abuja, Port Harcourt and Enugu

Verified 24 Oct 2026. Every row was checked on the academy's own live web page that day (URL in the Verification column). 20 rows: 19 academies, one of them with two campuses.

**Shortfall, stated plainly:** the task asks for 30, and I could verify 20. I didn't add any entry I couldn't confirm on a live page. The rejected candidates and the reasons are at the end.

**Decision makers:** none of the verified pages publicly names a Director of Training, Chief Instructor or Admissions lead, so that column says "not public" plus the official admissions route. I didn't take names from LinkedIn profiles or third-party sites, because the task forbids unverified entries and personal data.
